items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Gaçias, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory regarding this individual.

ctx.x: on and this fella, he was like the Frank Sinatra of North Africa. I could see why he was popular from the way he did his songs.

No, I don't remember the name but he was pretty famous. That was quite an experience just listening to the young man, especially when he was coming out of a song. His voice, the way he carried his voice up and down the register, he had a particular way of -- with North African songs.
